request: Create a jbh-* component adapter layer for jbh-app so pages stop using Ionic and external libraries directly. Goal: make future migrations easy (upgrade Angular/Ionic, remove Ionic, move to Vue). Agreed scope from discussion: 3 adapter layers — (1) UI components in their own folder, separate from the feature pages under src/app/ui (jbh-text-field, jbh-date-field, jbh-textarea, jbh-toggle, jbh-button, jbh-icon, jbh-table, jbh-card, empty state, skeleton, page header), each with its own CSS; (2) platform adapters (jbh-page shell + page-enter event, DialogService, ToastService, navigation) that hide Ionic-only behavior; (3) framework-free core (formatting logic in plain TS, pipes as thin adapters). Plain HTML (div, p, span, h1, label) is NOT wrapped. Wrap only: external-library elements, styled controls with behavior, repeated markup. Add a guard: a lint/check that forbids <ion-*> tags and @ionic/angular imports inside src/app/ui/**. Proposal, design and tasks only for now — the user wants to review the artifacts before any implementation.
